source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Enter BMC Web UI and navigate to the Network protocol properties page.
2. Check text displayed and make sure it is readable.
3. Enable DNS and fill out the information for the DNS server.
These changes should be made for both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses.
4. Save / Apply changes and wait 3 to 5 minutes.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. DNS information should be displayed correctly.
2. All displayed text must be readable.
3. All steps must be completed with all supported browsers.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" lan print 1 2>&1 | grep -iE "IP Address|MAC"; echo ---dns-set---; ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" lan set 1 dns1 8.8.8.8 2>&1; echo ---lan-print-dns---; ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" lan print 1 2>&1 | grep -i "dns"
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return `ipmitool lan print` IP/MAC/DNS lines after setting the DNS server, so the user confirms DNS is displayed and configured for IPv4 (IPv6 DNS + Web UI text readability still checked by operator in the GUI).
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: sets the BMC DNS server (write to network config) and validates IPv4 path; IPv6 DNS and the Web UI text/readability part of the criteria are operator-side GUI checks.

original_test_intent: Configure and visually verify IPv4/IPv6 DNS values and readable WebUI presentation across every supported browser, then prove stable resolution and persistence.
original_method: An engineer uses WebUI in the browser matrix; automated probes may validate DNS read-back and name resolution.
manual_activity: WebUI text readability and all-supported-browser completion are core engineer-observed criteria; the agent can only support configuration read-back and DNS probes.
safety_requirements: Do not insert public/unapproved resolvers or expose credentials.
Preserve existing management name resolution and alternate access.
Test both IP families and avoid clearing unrelated logs.
No automatic retry; restore prior values.
agent_execution_scope: Collect DNS configuration, resolver queries, network logs and correlate engineer browser screenshots.
Do not claim UI readability or verdict.
engineer_actions: Configure/inspect WebUI across supported browsers and approve changes.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: IPv4-only public DNS and hard-coded channel do not cover source; unsafe credentials rejected.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use approved dual-stack resolvers and protected read-only validation; keep browser/UI checks manual.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: IPv4+IPv6, 3-5 minute wait, all browsers, text readability and 10/10 minutes remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Snapshot DNS, test each approved browser while applying dual-stack values, wait stabilization, verify read-back/resolution/persistence, capture readability and restore.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact BMC WebUI and dual-stack network.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform BMC DNS and browser support matrix.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds resolver functionality, persistence and secure values.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Preserves all browsers and both IP families.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Bad DNS can break BMC name-based services.

project_override_considerations: Supported-browser list and DNS values are project inputs; record exact coverage rather than claiming an unspecified universe.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Source consistently requires dual-stack WebUI DNS coverage; DeepSeek's IPv4 subset is rejected but does not alter source.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Missing browser/DNS values are inputs. Manual UI acceptance makes the case MANUAL ONLY, not blocked.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Reclassifies PACKAGE to MANUAL ONLY due explicit cross-browser UI readability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Retains dual-stack/browser coverage and separates agent probes from human observation.

review_improvement: Prevents an IPv4-only command from passing a dual-stack, cross-browser presentation test.
independent_technical_reasoning: DNS queries are automatable, but readable text and correct rendering in each supported browser are visual acceptance facts; those cannot be inferred from network read-back.
